class.name: VMLResourceRouter
class.brief_description:
Native ResourceFormatLoader resolving `vml://namespace.path` to the winning provider.
原生 ResourceFormatLoader，把 `vml://namespace.path` 解析到胜出提供者。
class.description:
Registered automatically at engine start. Makes `load("vml://ns.path")` work, including in exported builds (native loaders are registered at the C++ level). Data ids (.json/.csv) are not Resources; read them with [method VMLModLoader.get_data] instead.
引擎启动时自动注册。让 `load("vml://ns.path")` 可用，包括导出版（原生加载器在 C++ 层注册）。数据 id（.json/.csv）不是 Resource；请改用 [method VMLModLoader.get_data] 读取。
